key_insight: Pairwise Surface DSC was the best-performing method for detecting liver CT segmentation failures across internal and external real-world clinical data.
clinical_relevance: This suggests automated failure detection for liver CT segmentation could help flag unreliable outputs before they are used in practice.
method: Compared six OOD detection methods on a deployed 3D nnU-Net liver CT segmentation model.
Tested on 400 internal patients and 100 external patients from nearly 70 sites in 7 countries.
Set thresholds using an independent 400-patient cohort and evaluated sensitivity, AUROC, and balanced accuracy.
evidence_signal: Pairwise Surface DSC achieved perfect sensitivity (1.00), near-perfect AUROC (0.97 internal; 1.00 external), and the highest balanced accuracy (0.94 internal; 0.88 external).
watch_item: Results are promising, but deployment will need validation across new scanners, sites, and workflow settings to ensure robustness.
paper_title: A Real-World Evaluation of Failure Detection for Liver CT Segmentation
